title: Rutlandbaconsouthamptonshakespeare
html_source: A portmanteau of several candidates for the “true” writer of Shakespeare’s works. Roger Manners, the 5th Earl of Rutland; Francis Bacon; Henry Wriothesley, 3rd Earl of Southhampton (also thought by some to be Shakespeare’s “fair youth”).
